prep.text: ICA shop (list below). Pantry and frozen items came with the Coop delivery on 3 Nov.
Lunch: orzo makes 3, eat it all.
Dinner: meatballs make 7. Box 2.5 for Sun lunch and 1 for Mon lunch; freeze 1.
Dinner: shawarma makes 6. Box 2.5 for Mon dinner and 1 for Tue lunch. Cook a double batch of bulgur.
No cooking. Evening: move 4 salmon fillets from freezer to fridge to thaw.
Dinner: traybake makes 4. Box 1 for Wed lunch.
Dinner: dal makes 4. Box 1 for Thu lunch.
Dinner: chicken makes 4. Box 1 for Fri lunch.
Assisted-quick dinner. Freezer buffer: 1 curry (from 1 Nov) + 1 meatballs — swap into any solo lunch.

recipes.name: Prawn & tomato orzo
ingredients: 400 g frozen peeled vannamei prawns, thawed under cold water
150 g frozen chopped onion; 2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp chilli flakes (adults: extra at the table)
250 g wholewheat orzo
400 g crushed tomatoes, 5 dl water or unsalted stock
1 lemon, flat-leaf parsley, 1 tbsp butter
steps: Cook onion in oil until the water is gone and it turns golden, 8–10 min.
Add purée, paprika and chilli; fry 1–2 min until the purée darkens.
Add orzo, tomatoes and water. Simmer 10–12 min, stirring, until the orzo is tender.
Stir in prawns; heat 2–3 min until hot through.
Off the heat, stir in butter, lemon zest, juice and plenty of parsley.

recipes.name: Swedish meatballs with mash & braised red cabbage
ingredients: 750 g beef mince (nötfärs)
1 dl rolled oats, 1 dl milk, 1 egg, 100 g frozen chopped onion (thawed, squeezed), ½ tsp ground allspice (kryddpeppar), ¼ tsp nutmeg, black pepper
1.5 kg potatoes, scrubbed; 1–2 dl milk, 1 tbsp unsalted butter
½ red cabbage, shredded; 1 apple, grated; 1 tbsp rapeseed oil; 1 tbsp water; ½ tsp cinnamon; 1 tbsp rice vinegar
250 g mushrooms (champinjoner), finely chopped; 1 tbsp butter
2 dl crème fraîche, 2 dl unsalted stock, flat-leaf parsley
steps: Soak oats in milk 5 min; mix with mince, egg, onion, allspice, nutmeg and pepper. Roll ~40 balls.
Air fry in both air fryers at 200°C for 10–12 min, shaking halfway, until well browned.
Boil potatoes with skin 20 min; mash with milk and butter.
Braise cabbage, apple and cinnamon in oil and water, lid on, 15 min. Stir in the vinegar.
Fry mushrooms in butter on high heat until deep brown, 8 min. Add crème fraîche and stock; simmer 5 min. Plenty of pepper, then parsley.
recipes.note: Freezes well — freeze 1 portion as buffer.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma bowls with bulgur & crispy chickpeas
ingredients: 900 g chicken thigh fillets (kycklinglårfilé)
2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp turmeric, ½ tsp cinnamon; 1 lemon; 2 tbsp olive oil
1 can chickpeas, rinsed and dried
6 dl bulgur (for Sun + Mon)
2 cucumbers, 3 tomatoes, 2 spring onions, flat-leaf parsley
3 dl Turkish yoghurt, 2 tbsp tahini
steps: Toss chicken with spices, lemon zest, half the juice and 1 tbsp oil.
Air fry chicken at 200°C for 14–16 min, shaking halfway; slice.
Air fry chickpeas with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of cumin at 200°C for 12 min in the second air fryer.
Cook bulgur. Chop cucumber and tomato; snip spring onion and parsley with scissors.
Whisk yoghurt with tahini and the rest of the lemon juice; build bowls.

recipes.name: Salmon & root veg traybake with dill yoghurt
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets (laxfilé), thawed
500 g beetroot, 3 carrots, 2 parsnips, in wedges
2 tbsp rapeseed oil; 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, black pepper
2 dl Turkish yoghurt, fresh dill, 1 lemon, olive oil to finish
steps: Toss root veg with oil, thyme, cumin, paprika and pepper. Roast at 220°C for 25 min, until the edges char.
Push veg aside, add salmon, top with lemon zest and pepper. Roast 12 min more.
Mix yoghurt with plenty of chopped dill and half the lemon juice.
Squeeze the rest of the lemon over the veg, drizzle with olive oil and serve.

recipes.name: Red lentil & spinach dal with flatbread
ingredients: 3 dl red lentils, rinsed
100 g frozen chopped onion; 4 cm ginger, grated; pinch of asafoetida (hing)
1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp garam masala (1 for the end); 1 tbsp tomato purée
400 g crushed tomatoes, 400 ml coconut milk, 5 dl water
225 g frozen chopped spinach; 1 lemon; 1 tbsp butter
Wholewheat tortillas, warmed; Turkish yoghurt
steps: Cook onion in oil until the water is gone and it turns golden, 8–10 min. Add ginger, hing, cumin, turmeric, 1 tsp garam masala and purée; fry 2 min.
Add lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and water. Simmer 20 min, stirring.
Stir in spinach; 3 min. Finish with butter, the rest of the garam masala and lemon juice.
Warm tortillas 2 min in the air fryer; serve with yoghurt.

recipes.name: Ginger-spring onion chicken with noodles & pak choi
ingredients: 700 g chicken thigh fillets, in strips
4 cm ginger grated, 1 tbsp sesame oil, ½ tsp ground white or black pepper
Sauce: 1 bunch spring onions, finely sliced; 4 cm ginger, grated; 3 tbsp rapeseed oil; 2 tbsp rice vinegar; 1 lime
250 g egg noodles
2 pak choi, halved; 2 carrots, in ribbons
1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted; low-salt soy at the table for adults
steps: Toss chicken with ginger, sesame oil and pepper.
Air fry chicken at 200°C for 12–14 min, shaking halfway, until golden.
Sauce: put spring onion and ginger in a heatproof bowl. Heat the oil until shimmering, pour over (it sizzles), then stir in vinegar and lime juice.
Cook noodles; add pak choi and carrot for the last 2 min. Drain.
Toss noodles with half the sauce; top with chicken, the rest of the sauce and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Salmon burgers, wedges & cucumber salad
ingredients: 1 pack frozen salmon burgers (laxburgare), lower-salt
600 g potatoes, in wedges; 1 tbsp oil; 1 tsp paprika
1 cucumber, fresh dill, 1 dl Turkish yoghurt, ½ lemon
steps: Toss wedges with oil and paprika. Air fry at 200°C for 20 min, shaking twice.
Salmon burgers in the second air fryer at 190°C for 10–12 min.
Slice cucumber thinly; mix with dill, yoghurt and lemon juice.

items: Pak choi × 2, spring onions × 2 bunches (shawarma, chicken sauce)
Frozen chopped onion (hackad lök, fryst) 450 g × 1
Large peeled prawns 400 g — hand-pick (not small räkor)
